receipt.schema: Original slim receipt with record_id/retrieved_utc/files; exact file entries name/url/bytes/sha256/zenodo_checksum. No invented transport status or synthesized API file objects.

metadata_requirements.description: A sharp Cartier-index rigidity criterion for singular Kähler–Einstein Fanos and an explicitly attributed cubic metric compactification application in dimensions at least five.
metadata_requirements.citation_title: Metric rigidity at the boundary of cubic compactifications
metadata_requirements.abstract: We deduce a sharp Cartier-index criterion for complex-structure rigidity on singular Kähler–Einstein Fano varieties. If −K_X = rL with L ample Cartier and r > dim(X)/2 + 1, then the tangent sheaf is stable and every parallel orthogonal complex structure on the regular locus equals the given one or its negative. The proof combines the decomposition theorem of Druel–Guenancia–Păun with a Hilbert-polynomial index bound and local positive-Ricci curvature. Applied to cubic n-fold limits, n ≥ 5, it identifies the ordinary metric Gromov–Hausdorff compactification with cubic GIT modulo conjugation, including the singular boundary. We also record the complex-preserving comparison as an attributed consequence of the unrestricted ordinary-double-point gap, Li–Liu's global Reeb minimum, and Spotti–Sun's established transfer. The complex algebraic comparison is already publicly stated in stronger form by Kong–Shen–Zhao–Zhao; no first-solution claim is made.

complete_original_verdicts: promotion.json reviews.*.verdict stores the full original object; root_authority_entry and root_clearance_record are separate exact authorities. Original pending/null/false history is not converted into a PASS.
public_exclusions: No internal audit counts, hashes, acquisition failures, root review dates, custody history, review controls or reviewer narratives. Mathematical theorem dependencies and prior-credit limits remain explicit.
